verdict.rationale: DBOS supports cron-based scheduled workflows and inter-workflow messaging/signals (dbos-docs-7, dbos-docs-8), which enable some automatic triggering of actions, but there is no documented declarative 'rules engine' for arbitrary event conditions (e.g., webhooks, external event streams) beyond message-passing between workflows. missing for 10: a general event-condition-action rule definition mechanism, evidence of triggering from external/business events (not just schedules or intra-workflow signals), and independent corroboration of rule-based automation use cases.
